line.forward15-choice.text: Choice Scenario — We want avoid large troop movements for our big offensives, so we have decided that an army stays in the region, whrere it is deployed. You have to come to a decision, where you want to fight. You have three options: — You can fight against the Heeresgruppe North: — This is the easiest and shortest path. You will attack the Germans at Leningrad and will follow them to Courland. — You can fight against the Heeresgruppe Mitte: — This can be tough, because you will have the option to fight against west allied troops.
